title: How Tourists Pay in China in 2026: Foreign Cards Now Work | China Travel Expert
description:
Wondering how you'll actually pay for anything in China? Here's the 2026 reality.

China runs on the phone: most shops, stalls, taxis and noodle spots want a QR scan, and many won't take cash or a foreign card at the counter. The fix is simple now — both Alipay and WeChat Pay let international visitors link an overseas card (Visa, Mastercard and more) with no Chinese bank account. You verify with your passport, and setup only takes a few minutes. Alipay's "Tour Pass" mode has the clearest English if it's your first time.

🧭 Expert Tip: Add your card at home before you fly — while your bank's verification texts still reach your usual number. Fees and limits change, so check the current terms in the app.
